[P2] Account for arguments consumed by an earlier rest parameter

For `const helper = async (...args) => args[1].step(async () => 1)`, the callback `async ctx => helper('tag', ctx)` performs a durable operation but is reported. The forwarded argument has index 1, while `fn.params` contains only the rest parameter at index 0, so this returns `"no"` before reaching the rest-parameter guard. Check whether an earlier rest parameter consumes the argument and return `"unknown"` in that case. Add a valid regression case with the context forwarded after another argument.
